title: Place CRUD service with types, validation, and geo auto-lookup
description: Implement the Place service layer: TypeScript interfaces, Yup validation schemas, Prisma repository functions, and business logic service with geo auto-lookup integration. The Place model is already defined in foundation's Prisma schema (model Place, lines 631-668 of TDD). This story creates the service that wraps Prisma operations and integrates foundation's getCityCoords utility to auto-populate lat/lng on create/update. Note: dispatch-api service key not yet in packages.json — depends on foundation BE-001 creating the API package.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript interfaces defined: Place, CreatePlaceInput, UpdatePlaceInput matching Prisma schema fields (name, address, address2, city, state, zip, latitude, longitude, geoSource, facilityType, operatingHours, receivingHours, appointmentRequired, dockType, contactName, contactPhone, contactEmail, checkInProcedures, lumperRequired, ppeRequired, notes, contactId)

FacilityType enum with 16 values: WAREHOUSE, DISTRIBUTION_CENTER, CROSS_DOCK, COLD_STORAGE, PORT, RAIL_YARD, TRUCK_STOP, DROP_YARD, MANUFACTURING, RETAIL, FARM, CONSTRUCTION_SITE, MILITARY, GOVERNMENT, RESIDENTIAL, OTHER
DockType enum with 4 values: DOCK_HIGH, GROUND_LEVEL, BOTH, NONE
Yup validation schema for CreatePlaceInput: name (required, string), city (required, string), state (required, 2-char string); all other fields optional with correct types
Yup validation schema for UpdatePlaceInput: all fields optional (partial update)

Place repository with Prisma operations: create, findById (excludes deleted), findMany (paginated, filterable by facilityType/state/contactId, searchable by name/city/state, sortable, excludes deleted), update, softDelete (sets deletedAt), typeaheadSearch (lightweight: id, name, city, state, facilityType, contactName, contactId — min 2 chars, excludes deleted)

Place service wraps repository with business logic: on create/update, calls getCityCoords(city, state) from foundation — if found, sets latitude/longitude and geoSource=AUTO; if not found, leaves lat/lng null
If client sends latitude/longitude explicitly with geoSource=MANUAL, service preserves manual values and does not call getCityCoords
findMany supports pagination: default limit 25, max 100, returns { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasMore } }
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision foundation L-009)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
